persona_groups.name_zh: 通勤访客与国际来访者
公共服务与场地运营人员

recruitment_targets.name_en: People who do not use smartphones

participation_channels.hybrid_equivalence_rule: Offline, telephone and online evidence receive the same coding, response deadline, decision status and publication trail.
participation_channels.no_smartphone_route: No participant needs a smartphone, account, QR code or personal device to take part or receive a response.

compensation_and_affordability_rule: Budget participation time, travel, access support, interpretation and carer/companion costs before recruitment; participation is free and basic public service is never conditional on attendance, payment, membership or data surrender.
accessible_materials: read-aloud, interpretation, tactile/raised-line or seated map review on request
advance issue of materials with breaks and companion participation

affected_user_decision_rights.rights_holder: affected users and their chosen representative or access supporter
affected_user_decision_rights.override_rule: A sponsor, supplier or facilitator cannot override an unresolved affected-user safety or rights stop; reopening requires published corrective evidence and renewed affected-user review.

governance.conflict_disclosure: Facilitators, authors, sponsor/site roles, suppliers and reviewers disclose interests before evidence review; material conflicts trigger recusal and are recorded in the published decision log.
governance.complaints: Accept staffed, telephone, paper and optional digital complaints without requiring the disputed system; acknowledge, assign an independent review role, publish the route and preserve appeal and anti-retaliation protections.
governance.output_publication: Publish the method, recruitment target and gaps, accessible anonymised evidence, accepted/rejected/deferred changes with reasons, dissent, conflicts, decision and next gate; never imply that a planned session occurred.

inputs: preferred M carrier concept plan and P01-P05 sequence
shade, rest, wayfinding, queue-bypass and staffed-help checklist
official boundary, title and field survey listed as missing inputs
stages.facilitator_role: independent accessibility facilitator pending appointment; site and service roles attend without controlling participant findings
accessible_format: step-free accompanied route or equivalent seated map review
tactile/raised-line route material and human interpretation on request
paper, telephone and optional digital response of equal standing
stages.decision_question: Can every affected user complete the same public task through a continuous route and reach visible staffed help without using AI or a smartphone?
evidence_captured: coded barrier location or concept-plan reference
task affected, severity and affected group
participant-proposed change, dissent and facilitator response
photo only after specific consent and without unnecessary faces
stages.privacy_boundary: No face recognition, precise continuous tracking, health diagnosis or compulsory identity; contact details are separated from findings and deleted after agreed follow-up.
stages.stop_condition: Stop route release when the same task lacks a continuous accessible path, safe waiting or visible staffed transfer; do not infer field conditions from the concept drawing.
stages.feedback_to_design: Barrier records revise P01-P05 circulation, component placement, rest/shade intervals and the M-carrier selection gate; every accepted, rejected or deferred change receives a reason.

inputs: SC-01 through SC-12 public AI service records
refusal, error, appeal, no-smartphone, shutdown and restoration cards
stages.facilitator_role: neutral service-design facilitator pending appointment; technical authors disclose assumptions and cannot overrule affected-user safety objections
accessible_format: plain-language read-aloud and interpretation on request
keyboard-accessible remote copy and telephone participation
breaks, companion participation and non-verbal response options
stages.decision_question: For each SC-01-SC-12 task, are the AI boundary, same-task human route, complaint, correction, pause, deletion and restoration rules understandable and usable?
evidence_captured: chosen route, refusal/error/appeal step and unresolved barrier
rule, interface or staffing change required before release
stages.privacy_boundary: Use fictional task cards and no real case files; do not collect account credentials, precise journeys, protected-characteristic data beyond voluntary accessibility needs, or model-training data.
stages.stop_condition: Stop a scenario before release if same-task staffed service, accessible complaint, safe data use, human authority or physical/data shutdown cannot be demonstrated.
stages.feedback_to_design: Findings update the matching SC record, tabletop contract, staffed route, prohibited inputs, pause threshold and procurement acceptance evidence before a new review.

inputs: stage-one barrier register and stage-two scenario change log
M carrier concept, cost bands, procurement clauses and unresolved official inputs
public AI register, complaints route, conflicts and evidence limitations
stages.facilitator_role: independent chair and accessibility support pending appointment; conflicts are declared and affected users deliberate before sponsor or supplier representatives
accessible_format: hybrid in-person, paper, telephone and keyboard-accessible online evidence pack
plain-language bilingual summary with large-print and read-aloud options
advance materials, paid access support, breaks and companion participation
recorded reasoned decision without publishing participant identity by default
stages.decision_question: Does evidence justify continue, modify or stop, and are accessibility, human service, complaint handling and data-risk conditions met before any authorized pilot?
evidence_captured: majority, minority and unresolved-input statement for publication
stages.privacy_boundary: Publish decisions, evidence and dissent without participant names, quotations, disability details or contact data unless separate informed publication consent is recorded.
stages.stop_condition: Stop progression when affected users identify an unresolved failure in same-task human service, route accessibility, complaint handling or unsafe data use, or when a material conflict is undisclosed.
stages.feedback_to_design: A modify decision returns named evidence to the relevant carrier, scenario, procurement or operations record; stop keeps ordinary service and publishes close-out and restoration requirements.

evidence_boundary: This file is an executable competition protocol, not evidence of attendance, consent, public approval, a field audit, authorization, procurement or accessibility certification.
